Chiyo: raster sprite sheet — NOT YET SUPPLIED

Expected file: chiyo_sheet.png (this directory)
Reader: src/three/chiyoSprite.ts

Status
------
The drawing does not exist yet. The image-generation quota for the session in
which this pipeline was written had already been exhausted, so no new artwork
could be produced. Until the file is added, src/three/models.ts keeps using the
previous programmatic art for Chiyo. Nothing breaks: loadChiyoSheet() resolves
to null and the fallback stays on screen.

Expected format
---------------
Grid: 4 columns x 3 rows (12 cells), same convention as gabriela_sheet.png.
Background: transparent, or a uniform near-white matte (it is removed in the
shader at sample time, the same way Gabriela's sheet is handled).

Cells read by the current code:
  0 - front, standing idle
  1 - front, stirring with the ladle
  2 - front, idle variation (breathing)
  3 - front, stirring follow-through

Remaining cells are reserved for side and back views if she ever walks.

Character notes
---------------
74 years old, slightly stooped, shorter and rounder than Gabriela.
Silver-grey hair in a neat bun with a small wooden hairpin.
Indigo kimono under a white cooking apron (kappogi).
Brown wooden geta sandals. Warm, kind expression.
Consistent in scale with gabriela_sheet.png so both read as the same world.

Once the PNG is dropped in, Chiyo switches over automatically on next load.
